name: Lemonade!: Doki Doki Say My Heart
source:
Hi, Lemon Acidee here.
OK, let's say...that you want to live a world of adventures in DDSMH but do not say spoilers, OK?

This universe is always developed in the history of Lemonade.

[Roughly translated from [url=https://teammakers-dori.itch.io/lemonadedemo-ddsmyheart]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
嗨，这里是柠檬酸。
好吧，假设……你想在DDSMH中生活一个充满冒险的世界，但不要剧透，好吗？

这个宇宙在Lemonade的历史中一直在发展。

[大致翻译自[url=https://teammakers-dori.itch.io/lemonadedemo-ddsmyheart]itch.io[/url]]
